conservation.help_by: Give wildlife space; pick reef-safe sunscreen and careful finning.
conservation.caution_against: Don’t feed fish, chase animals, or pocket living souvenirs.

life_info.eating: Mostly sponges, plus algae and small invertebrates. Picks carefully at sponges — royalty with a picky menu.
life_info.mating: Pairs defend a home stretch of reef.
life_info.habitat: Clear Caribbean reefs with caves and coral heads for shelter. Shy of snorkelers but curious from a polite distance.

fun_facts: A blue crown-like spot on the head earns the royal nickname.
One of the brightest billboards on a healthy reef.

conservation.help_by: Anchor in sand, not grass; support seagrass-friendly boat habits.
conservation.caution_against: Don’t drive propellers through meadows or dig up plants.

life_info.eating: Algae and organic film grazed with a rasping tongue. Slow lawnmower of the grass beds.
life_info.mating: Egg strands look like sandy spaghetti on the bottom.
life_info.habitat: Seagrass beds and sandy shallows. Overharvested in many places — check local rules.

fun_facts: The pink shell interior is a Caribbean icon.
They hop-lurch forward on a strong muscular foot.
